data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €888
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterstadt-Nord issued the income tax assessment for 2025 on 27 April 2026. Tax is set at €8,214.00, and after withheld wage tax you get a refund of €888.00.
data.explanation: This is your final income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025. Because more wage tax was withheld than due, €888 will be transferred to the account named in the letter. The home office costs were only recognised at the flat rate (Homeoffice-Pauschale), not as a full study-room deduction. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office; the app shows the deadline. Keep the notice safe. A tax adviser can help if you want to contest it.
data.tax_note: Income tax assessment for 2025; it records your taxable income and the tax set for that year.
